'''''Jess''''' was a group of [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|Freighters]] belonging to the [[Habassa]]. Jess 6, 7, and 8 were all operated by the Habassan convoy that was attacked by [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]]. [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] came to their aid in a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]]. Jess 6 was disabled by the Imperials and was attempted to be looted by [[Slick (BFF-1 bulk freighter)|''Slick'']], an Imperial freighter, but it was destroyed. Jess 9 hypered in with some [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and saved the crew. Keyan was successful in stopping the attack.
